AI_MF_01.name: Logic and Discrete Structures
AI_MF_01.description: Logic and Discrete Structures course provides theoretical foundations of discrete mathematics and logic for computer science and AI modeling.

AI_MF_02.name: Univariate Calculus
AI_MF_02.description: Fundamental concepts of univariate calculus including limits, derivatives, integration, and applications in mathematical modeling.

AI_MF_03.name: Multivariate Calculus
AI_MF_03.description: Advanced concepts of multivariate calculus, multiple integrals, vector calculus, and functions of several variables.

AI_MF_04.name: Linear Structure
AI_MF_04.description: Core concepts of linear algebra, vector spaces, linear transformations, matrices, and eigenvalues for AI operations.

AI_MF_05.name: Statistics and Probability
AI_MF_05.description: Introduction to probability theory, random variables, distributions, parameter estimation, and statistical hypothesis testing.

AI_AME_01.name: AI Ethics
AI_AME_01.description: Overview of social, ethical, legal, and safety implications of designing and deploying artificial intelligence systems.

AI_AME_02.name: Data Science and Machine Learning
AI_AME_02.description: Comprehensive introduction to data analysis, machine learning algorithms, model evaluation, and regression/classification tasks.

AI_AME_03.name: Knowledge Representation and Reasoning
AI_AME_03.description: Formal methods for encoding knowledge in logical, semantic, and rule-based paradigms, enabling automated system reasoning.

AI_AME_04.name: Search and Optimization
AI_AME_04.description: Graph search, heuristic methods, and optimization techniques for solving complex state-space decision-making problems.

AI_AME_05.name: Deep Learning
AI_AME_05.description: Multi-layer neural network architectures, backpropagation, convolutional networks, sequence models, and training optimization.

AI_AME_06.name: Computer Vision
AI_AME_06.description: Image processing, object detection, segmentation, and modern visual recognition models utilizing convolutional architectures.

AI_AME_07.name: Natural Language Processing
AI_AME_07.description: Computational linguistics, text classification, word embeddings, transformers, and sequence-to-sequence language processing models.

AI_AME_08.name: Generative AI
AI_AME_08.description: State-of-the-art generative architectures, diffusion models, GANs, autoencoders, and large language models (LLMs) techniques.

AI_PF_01.name: Programming Foundations 1
AI_PF_01.description: Introduction to computational thinking, programming syntax, variables, logical statements, control structures, and functional design.

AI_PF_02.name: Programming Foundations 2
AI_PF_02.description: Advanced programming concepts focusing on object-oriented programming (OOP), design principles, and software structure.

AI_PF_03.name: Data Structures and Algorithms
AI_PF_03.description: Design and analysis of basic data structures (lists, trees, graphs) and computational algorithm complexities.

AI_DSSD_01.name: Databases
AI_DSSD_01.description: Relational data model, SQL syntax, database normalization, indexing, transactions, and schema design principles.

AI_DSSD_02.name: Data Engineering Foundations
AI_DSSD_02.description: Data integration, ETL pipelines, big data storage components, stream processing, and analytics architecture paradigms.

AI_DSSD_03.name: Introduction to Computer Architecture and Operating Systems
AI_DSSD_03.description: Fundamentals of hardware structures, assembly language, OS process scheduling, memory management, and file systems.

AI_DSSD_04.name: Architecture, Engineering, and Operations of AI Applications
AI_DSSD_04.description: Deployment, monitoring, scalability, and operations of artificial intelligence models (MLOps) in cloud production ecosystems.

AI_DSSD_05.name: Computer System Networks
AI_DSSD_05.description: Principles of computer networks, Internet protocol suite, routing models, network layers, and standard communication security.

AI_DSSD_06.name: AI Product Design
AI_DSSD_06.description: Design thinking, user experience design, and methodology for conceiving interactive software applications leveraging AI solutions.

AI_DSSD_07.name: AI Product Development Project
AI_DSSD_07.description: Capstone software development project integrating AI components, requirements gathering, design, testing, and implementation.

AI_GRUR_01.name: Religion
AI_GRUR_01.description: Foundational values and character building within the student's religious framework.

AI_GRUR_02.name: English
AI_GRUR_02.description: Academic English writing, reading comprehension, presentation skills, and scientific communication vocabulary.

AI_GRUR_03.name: Integrated Character Development
AI_GRUR_03.description: Integrated character development course covering national values, ethics, logic, and scientific thinking.

AI_GRUR_04.name: Internship
AI_GRUR_04.description: Hands-on industrial work experience implementing computer science and artificial intelligence solutions in professional projects.

AI_GRUR_05.name: Research Methodology and Scientific Writing
AI_GRUR_05.description: Scientific thinking, research formulation, literature review, bibliography management, and academic paper structure.

AI_GRUR_06.name: Undergraduate Thesis
AI_GRUR_06.description: Independent academic research project representing the culmination of the undergraduate program.

AI_PE_01.name: AI Databases
AI_PE_01.description: Elective course covering database structures designed to store, retrieve, and operate on AI structures and vectors.

AI_PE_02.name: Bioinformatics
AI_PE_02.description: Elective course applying computational algorithms and AI models to analyze biological sequence data.

AI_PE_03.name: Data & Information Visualization
AI_PE_03.description: Elective course exploring concepts and techniques to design interactive graphical dashboards mapping data.

AI_PE_04.name: Data Mining
AI_PE_04.description: Elective course analyzing pattern extraction methodologies, association rules, and dataset clustering techniques.

AI_PE_05.name: Classical Machine Learning
AI_PE_05.description: Elective course investigating non-neural networks machine learning models, decision trees, and SVMs.

AI_PE_06.name: Edge AI
AI_PE_06.description: Elective course deploying and optimizing light machine learning models on microcontrollers and embedded devices.

AI_PE_07.name: Graph Machine Learning
AI_PE_07.description: Elective course teaching Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and topological data analysis paradigms.

AI_PE_08.name: Information Retrieval
AI_PE_08.description: Elective course analyzing search engine architectures, indexing, tf-idf, and vector search strategies.

AI_PE_09.name: Knowledge Graph
AI_PE_09.description: Elective course modeling relationships and semantic facts into queryable structural databases.

AI_PE_10.name: Large-scale Social Data Analytics
AI_PE_10.description: Elective course applying models to investigate patterns in large-scale social networks and text trends.

AI_PE_11.name: Logic Programming
AI_PE_11.description: Elective course studying logic programming concepts, Prolog syntax, and declarative computational reasoning.

AI_PE_12.name: Quantitative Forecasting
AI_PE_12.description: Elective course detailing mathematical models for time-series forecasting, ARIMA, and modern sequence predictors.

AI_PE_13.name: Reinforcement Learning
AI_PE_13.description: Elective course exploring Markov Decision Processes, policy gradients, Q-learning, and deep RL applications.

AI_PE_14.name: Robotics
AI_PE_14.description: Elective course mapping sensory input, kinematic algorithms, and AI agent control loops in robotic environments.

AI_PE_15.name: Spoken Language Processing
AI_PE_15.description: Elective course addressing audio signal analysis, automatic speech recognition, and speech synthesis systems.
